source_user: Choose between tensor and pipeline parallelism for a latency-sensitive multi-GPU service. State the assumptions needed. Scenario variant 180: include an explicit falsifiable hypothesis and a controlled experiment.
source_assistant: Answer should state assumptions, a falsifiable hypothesis, measurements, expected confounders, and rollback criteria. Minimum technical points: compare per-GPU memory, communication topology, layer partitioning, batch and microbatch behavior, synchronization, latency target, and failure/reconfiguration costs.
corrected_answer: Scenario variant 180: choose TP or PP only after measuring the workload; the label does not determine the answer. Assume the model graph, precision, GPU count and type, usable HBM (GiB), interconnect topology, software versions, clock policy, request-length/arrival distributions, concurrency, batching policy, and latency/availability/quality SLOs are recorded; unknown values are estimates, not platform facts. Enumerate feasible TP degrees and PP layer partitions. TP reduces per-GPU parameter, optimizer, and activation memory approximately with its shard degree but adds per-layer collective communication, synchronization, topology and straggler costs; PP partitions layers and can reduce collective traffic but requires balanced stage memory/compute, activation transfers, microbatch scheduling, and pays pipeline bubbles and queueing. Include batch size, microbatch count, synchronization points, and the cost and operational blast radius of failure and reconfiguration. Pre-register the falsifiable hypothesis: at the target offered load, the selected configuration reduces held-out end-to-end p99 by at least M ms or M% versus the best feasible alternative while meeting p50, TTFT, TPOT, throughput, error-rate, quality, and availability gates; otherwise conclude no winner. Run randomized repeated paired trials on equivalent isolated hardware with identical traces, warm-up, seeds, versions, clocks, and load. Tune on one split and evaluate on a disjoint split stratified by prompt/output length and concurrency. Report p50/p95/p99 latency in ms, TTFT/TPOT in ms/token, tokens/s, GPU HBM GiB, utilization, collective and activation-transfer time in ms, synchronization wait, pipeline-bubble fraction, queue depth, retries, errors, quality, and recovery/reconfiguration time with confidence intervals; separate measured values from estimates and record confounders such as placement, thermal throttling, kernel/autotune changes, NUMA, network contention, and scheduler effects. Use only authorized, isolated failure tests. Adopt the configuration only if all gates and the pre-registered effect hold across repeats; canary it with a kill switch, checkpoint/config rollback, drained traffic, and a documented recovery path. Roll back on any SLO, quality, error-rate, or recovery regression; preserve artifacts and treat an inconclusive result as evidence_required for expert review.

Pre-register the falsifiable hypothesis: at the target offered load, the selected configuration reduces held-out end-to-end p99 by at least M ms or M% versus the best feasible alternative while meeting p50, TTFT, TPOT, throughput, error-rate, quality, and availability gates; otherwise conclude no winner. Run randomized repeated paired trials on equivalent isolated hardware with identical traces, warm-up, seeds, versions, clocks, and load. Tune on one split and evaluate on a disjoint split stratified by prompt/output length and concurrency. Report p50/p95/p99 latency in ms, TTFT/TPOT in ms/token, tokens/s, GPU HBM GiB, utilization, collective and activation-transfer time in ms, synchronization wait, pipeline-bubble fraction, queue depth, retries, errors, quality, and recovery/reconfiguration time with confidence intervals; separate measured values from estimates and record confounders such as placement, thermal throttling, kernel/autotune changes, NUMA, network contention, and scheduler effects. Use only authorized, isolated failure tests. Adopt the configuration only if all gates and the pre-registered effect hold across repeats; canary it with a kill switch, checkpoint/config rollback, drained traffic, and a documented recovery path. Roll back on any SLO, quality, error-rate, or recovery regression; preserve artifacts and treat an inconclusive result as evidence_required for expert review.
